A0.relaxed: Bonjour, and welcome. I am so glad you are here. This is your very first step, and you do not need any French yet. This is French for your work, and you have chosen a relaxed pace: a few lessons a week, with no rush. A little each time adds up faster than you think. Do not worry about getting everything right. Listen, repeat, and be kind to yourself. When you are ready, let us begin. Allons-y.
